mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, device_name, device_type, serial_number, status FROM t_health_device WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_health_device (user_id, device_name, device_type, serial_number, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{deviceName}, #{deviceType}, #{serialNumber}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_health_device SET user_id=#{userId}, device_name=#{deviceName}, device_type=#{deviceType}, serial_number=#{serialNumber}, status=#{status} WHERE id=#{id}
